claim: Liu, Yu and Zhang report two separately provisioned 16-host AWS executions. Selective receiver-to-gateway non-delivery allowed 112/225 calls and effects per block despite durable revocation receipt; normal and recovery phases produced zero effects. Each execution used 30 blocks.
falsifier: An independent reproduction preserving the signed revocation, blocked handoff, gateway membership, workload, barrier and resource-side observation fails to reproduce stale-authority effects; or resource-side evidence contradicts the reported counts.
firstUnsupportedArrow: Repeated controlled deployments → prevalence or enforcement effectiveness in independently operated production systems.
omissions: Same runtime and protocol in both topologies; repeatability is not independent replication
Conference wording appears in the manuscript; acceptance and peer-review status not independently verified
Finite paths and windows; no production incidence estimate
failures: Reported persisted-but-not-enforced revocation gap; not reproduced here
correction: Successful revocation in another deployment does not falsify this configuration. Separate protocol generalization from reproduction.
